result:
All 44 tests pass. I created two self-contained JUnit 5 test classes:

- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers empty/blank checks, trim/strip, equals, indexOf/contains, substring family, join, split, replace, capitalize/swapCase, padding, abbreviate (incl. `IllegalArgumentException`), numeric/alpha checks, reverse/repeat, defaultString, startsWith/endsWith, countMatches, Levenshtein distance (incl. `NullPointerException`), case conversion, truncate, toString/valueOf, and wrap/unwrap — each with null/empty/boundary cases.
- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/StrBuilderAgentTest.java` — covers constructors, append variants (including null-text defaults and custom null text), insert/delete, out-of-bounds exceptions for `charAt`/`deleteCharAt`/`setLength`, replace, reverse, indexOf/contains, startsWith/endsWith, substring helpers, capacity/length management, clear, equals/hashCode, char array extraction, separators, padding, and `build()`/`size()`.

Both compile under `--release 8` with no lambdas/diamond operators (using anonymous `Executable` classes for exception assertions), and `./_tools/test.sh` reports all 44 test methods passing.
